.. _refT0_Empty:
Empty Template
========
This empty template contains a barebones IdentityServer project.
It contains only what you need to start building your own IdentityServer application.

It is ready to run and can be used with our UI template and Quickstarts.

.. note::
    The default launch URL navigates to the Discovery document. To change this, open the ``launchSettings.json`` file in the Properties folder and edit the ``launchUrl`` property.
